note: Canonical, deduped gap registry compacted from the multi-agent judge sweep (35 confirmed findings -> 30 canonical gaps). severity = verifier-CORRECTED (honest) grade, not the panels' raw self-grade. architect = BMAD persona that owns the spec. effort S/M/L per the roadmap.
severity_truth: 0 critical, 1 genuine HIGH (G01), ~12 MEDIUM, rest LOW. Tamper detection still fires; no seal bypass survived.

gaps.title: Verdict-path contract mismatch (Python writes .cursor/... hardcoded; Dart resolves dynamically)
gaps.fix: Make Python honor Dart's resolution order (ORCH_ORCHESTRATION_DIR -> .adf-install.json -> probe); centralize path logic; add a non-.cursor layout runner test.

gaps.title: Policy gate is fail-OPEN on exception (broad try/except leaves policy_blocked=None -> seals anyway)
gaps.fix: Mirror the PROCESS gate fail-closed: on gate exception under enforced policy set policy_blocked=['policy_gate_error']; add exit-6 E2E + injected-exception-blocks-seal test.

gaps.title: Merkle root silently dropped from audit bundle (Dart reads proof['root'], Python writes 'merkle_root')
gaps.fix: Read proof['merkle_root'] (legacy 'root' fallback); fix the test fixture; assert moat.proof.root == real seal output; add presence/match check to verify_audit_bundle.py.

gaps.title: Mobile (APK) facts not folded into sealed Merkle root (no 'mobile' branch in _verdict_bytes)
gaps.fix: Add a 'mobile' branch to _verdict_bytes (fold apk_sha256 + key preview facts); record in proof metadata; correct the false comment at agent_runner.py:2851; add a mutate-sha-root-changes test.

gaps.title: Concurrent crew runs corrupt the integrity ledger (no single-flight lock per featureId)
gaps.fix: Add a per-featureId in-flight guard (Set/Mutex) in runCrewForFeature; reject or coalesce a second trigger while one is active.

gaps.title: Crew failure silently falls back to deterministic template spec (stamped 'ok', sealed as adf-crew, no audit trail)
gaps.fix: On run()==false write a crew-log.jsonl entry + state flag spec_source='deterministic_fallback'; surface in UI; seal under a distinct actor or block-on-fallback. (Timeout path already signals; only non-timeout path is silent.)

gaps.title: Open-questions elicitation wired but dead E2E (payload-shape mismatch: server nests under 'summary', panel reads top-level)
gaps.fix: Read detail['summary']['requirements_open_questions'] (or lift to top-level in server.dart); add a real-nested-shape screen test.

gaps.title: NVIDIA swarm timeout silently 120s not intended 240s (min() can only lower; _complete passes no timeout)
gaps.fix: _complete() passes timeout=int(env ADF_NVIDIA_TIMEOUT_SEC default 240), or make model_router.complete default read the env var.

gaps.title: Audio (ASR) + existing-repo ingest sources unbuilt/unwired (audio_ingest.py, repo_analyst.py do not exist)
gaps.fix: Build audio_ingest.py (ASR->transcript->extract) and repo_analyst.py (wrap code-review-graph MCP) + _load_sources branches + tests. OR descope plan/docs (S) to stop advertising them.

gaps.title: agent_runner.generate() has no per-call model=; app-gen path can't route models
gaps.fix: Add optional model=None to generate() and thread through call_with_retry to backend; default unchanged when omitted.

gaps.title: Static 'models' field fakes per-agent attribution the plan requires; no test
gaps.fix: model_router.complete() returns served (prov, model); crew collects per-role map into 'models' field; assert in a routing-aware test.

gaps.title: _tdd_red_baseline deps-absent guard has zero direct test coverage
gaps.fix: Add a test calling _tdd_red_baseline against an app dir with no node_modules; assert red is False, vacuous is False, 'deps absent' reason.

gaps.title: Requirements verdict content not validated; empty/garbage verdict file passes the gate (existence-only check)
gaps.fix: Parse verdict file in run() and require a PASS/REVISE token (reject empty/garbage); main() exits non-zero on REVISE; add the negative test.

gaps.title: backend/model Merkle-exclusion is correct but test-unproven (only created_at tested)
gaps.fix: Add two 3-line tests mirroring test_created_at_is_metadata_not_in_the_root for backend and model.

gaps.title: Audit-bundle proof endpoint shows only the LIVE policy verdict, never the sealed one (no dual display/staleness)
gaps.fix: Surface sealed verdict.policy alongside live result (sealed_policy_ok vs live_policy_ok); flag divergence.

gaps.title: process_facts nonce binding degrades to no-op when ADF_BUILD_NONCE unset (latent; production path wipes+UUIDs)
gaps.fix: Add a regression test asserting a planted _nonce='' dict is rejected under the production (wiped+UUID) path; optionally _read rejects artifacts lacking a _nonce key.

gaps.title: web_scraper urllib fallback has no robots.txt awareness (ToS-politeness gap, not a security hole)
gaps.fix: Parse target /robots.txt via urllib.robotparser in the urllib fallback; skip disallowed URLs; honor crawl-delay; add a test.

gaps.title: Dart POST /features parses only sources:[{url}|{path}]; multimodal intake fields + uploads absent
gaps.fix: Add multipart parsing + attachments/mockups/figma_url/reference_sites/audio/repo_path/data_files fields wired to doc_ingest/new modules. Pairs with G09.

gaps.title: gather() silently drops user URLs beyond max_pages=8 (no log/warn at >8)
gaps.fix: Log/surface a warning when targets truncated; document the cap; consider keeping all user URLs and capping only search-derived; add a >8-URL test.

gaps.title: web_scraper.scrape() is hard-truncate[:12000] + single LLM extract, not plan's chunk->rank->cite pipeline
gaps.fix: Implement chunk->rank->cite, OR route the slice through compaction.clip and downgrade the plan wording (S). Also removes the [:N] literal violating the stated invariant.

gaps.title: Wave-1 research-synth (Qwen per-domain-slice summarization) unimplemented (per-URL extract is the substitute)
gaps.fix: Implement the per-slice Qwen synth pass between gather() and Wave 2, OR formally retire research-synth from the design and document the per-URL extract as the accepted substitute (S).

gaps.title: Re-run cost claim unimplemented: every invocation runs the full 5-wave DAG (no cache/affected-agent skip)
gaps.fix: Implement per-wave content-hash caching + skip unchanged waves (L), OR correct the plan to drop the 'cheap re-run' claim and remove the unwritten test (S). Default: descope (S).

gaps.title: Stale model-science labels (docstrings/comments + a user-facing gate string cite Nemotron Ultra/DeepSeek R1; router runs Qwen/Super/v4-pro)
gaps.fix: Sweep the five label sites to actual default-path models; make the :239 PO-verdict string DYNAMIC (emit ids the router actually returned; show Ultra/R1 only at ADF_QUALITY=max); fix test docstring :60. No routing edits.

gaps.title: Red-without-green path doesn't assert persisted status='skipped'
gaps.fix: Add read_process_facts + assertEqual(status,'skipped') to the existing test.

gaps.title: Written requirements-draft.json 'sources' traceability never asserted on disk
gaps.fix: Add assertTrue(draft['sources']) to the existing on-disk test.

gaps.title: Swarm parallelism pool-bounded at 8; no test proves concurrent execution; 'massive parallel' overstates runtime concurrency
gaps.fix: Soften docstring/log to 'up to N concurrent workers (default 8) over 100s-1000s of tasks'; add a barrier/active_count test asserting >=2 concurrent and <=parallelism.

gaps.title: warm_node_modules 'APFS clonefile' fast path macOS-only; on Linux 'cp -c' is an ignored no-op -> deep copy mislabeled method='clone'
gaps.fix: Detect platform / use cp --reflink=auto on Linux for real CoW; report actual method per branch (clone/hardlink/copy); fix the docstring to mark clonefile macOS-only.

gaps.title: Missing test: cross-provider fallback when a provider exhausts retries and returns None
gaps.fix: Add a multi-candidate-role test where the first stubbed provider returns None; assert the second is invoked.

gaps.title: Dart nonInteractiveEnv falsely claims parity with Python NON_INTERACTIVE_ENV (15 of 21 keys; 6 missing)
gaps.fix: Add the six missing keys (TERM=dumb, PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1, PIP_PROGRESS_BAR=off, npm_config_update_notifier=false, ADBLOCK=1, HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1); ideally derive both maps from a shared source.

gaps.title: 'Honest scorecard' omits that every free/local build produced 0 working apps (NVIDIA 0/3, Ollama 0/1)
gaps.fix: Surface the free/local results in the doc - render the bench's existing 0/N fallback prose, or add an explicit row/footnote disclosing NVIDIA 0/3 and Ollama 0/1 with the 600s latency note.

validation_followup_not_a_code_fix: Per report 5.3 + roadmap #26: the highest-value NEXT ACTION is a real free-path E2E build (create->autopilot->crew->phases1/3-6->generate->verify->preview) proving the generated app boots+serves+passes its own tests and the sealed proof reflects it. Gated on free-tier API availability; tracked separately.
